svg.title: Latency
svg.desc: A product page request goes from the browser to the product service, which runs six database queries, then calls recommendations, then inventory, one after another. A timeline adds up each wait and the page takes 800 ms. Then the queries become one and the two calls run in parallel, and the same page takes 450 ms.
svg.text: Waits in a row stack up. One query and parallel calls: 800 ms to 450 ms.
